description: A quoted mixed-case function name and the unquoted name of the same letters are two functions, as PostgreSQL keeps them: "Label"() and label() each keep their own return type, "Scale"($1) types its placeholder from its own argument while scale($1) warns Q005, as the built-in scale(numeric) fits an unknown argument as well as the created scale(integer) and PostgreSQL refuses the call as not unique, "Series"() and series() give their own columns, a call of "Purge"() writes while one of purge() only reads, and a body calling purge() stays read-only. An unquoted LABEL() folds to label().
